P0 · Done — SQ-01: Storage/cache and reference architecture audit

Parent: backlog-c271f2bb931810eef633f7c7. Plan: docs/search-quality-plan.md.
Compared the reference source tools, DB mirror, in-process cache tiers and prompt caching with AiMate SQLCipher, chat recall, briefs, coverage checkpoints and evidence snapshots. Inspected knowledge-repository architecture and metadata. This is code-audit evidence, not live runtime performance or answer parity.

P0 · Planned — SQ-02: Matched reference benchmark and verified expected facts

Parent: backlog-c271f2bb931810eef633f7c7. Plan: docs/search-quality-plan.md.
Use the same questions, needed context, access and source versions. Score independently verified facts, coverage, citations and unsupported claims; record time/tokens/cost separately. Exact reference question/context and full answers still needed.

P0 · WIP — SQ-03: Dedicated scoped repository file/content search

Parent: backlog-c271f2bb931810eef633f7c7. Plan: docs/search-quality-plan.md.
First implementation batch. Add commit-pinned file discovery and bounded content search with explicit pagination/gaps, permission checks and independent disable switch. Test native/Responses providers, private mode, incomplete trees and source errors.

P0 · Planned — SQ-04: Knowledge-repository connection and selected indexing

Parent: backlog-c271f2bb931810eef633f7c7. Plan: docs/search-quality-plan.md.
Connect the approved Nexus repository by validated access. Ingest selected Markdown and metadata at pinned commits, preserving status, aliases/tags, scope, dates and evidence links. No credentials or automatic all-repository imports.

P0 · Planned — SQ-05: Structured reusable failures, observations and outcomes

Parent: backlog-c271f2bb931810eef633f7c7. Plan: docs/search-quality-plan.md.
Store symptoms/signatures, conditions, environment/version, evidence, diagnosis, resolution, actual outcome, reviewer/status and visibility. Keep private/candidate/shared separate; support corrections and retirement with provenance.

P0 · Planned — SQ-06: Relevant retrieval, ranking and optional reranking

Parent: backlog-c271f2bb931810eef633f7c7. Plan: docs/search-quality-plan.md.
Combine exact identifiers, metadata/aliases and full-text ranking. Check missed matches and irrelevant matches. Evaluate embeddings/reranking only when justified; do not send private content to a new provider implicitly.

P0 · Planned — SQ-07: Approved read-only project-data connector

Parent: backlog-c271f2bb931810eef633f7c7. Plan: docs/search-quality-plan.md.
Add an optional scoped data API/database adapter with freshness, row/time limits and dataset/denominator citations. Source endpoint/schema/access needs setup. Personal chat/config/vault records are not a domain-data mirror.

P0 · Planned — SQ-08: Thorough investigation and final evidence gate

Parent: backlog-c271f2bb931810eef633f7c7. Plan: docs/search-quality-plan.md.
Plan, inspect current sources, test past-case applicability, resolve contradictions and complete file/log coverage before a verdict. Persist checkpoints and state unresolved gaps if access/budget prevents finishing. Progress summaries must not expose hidden reasoning.

P0 · Planned — SQ-09: Cache tiers, freshness, invalidation and retention

Parent: backlog-c271f2bb931810eef633f7c7. Plan: docs/search-quality-plan.md.
Scope caches to credentials/workspace/source versions. Separate immutable content, mutable facts, retrieval indexes, past cases and provider prefix caching. Bound storage and mark freshness; test revoked/changed access and stale/conflicting data.

P0 · Planned — SQ-10: Verified Standard/Analysis routing for real investigations

Parent: backlog-c271f2bb931810eef633f7c7. Plan: docs/search-quality-plan.md.
Configure and verify the authorized Analysis model; preserve manual control and honest fallback. Verify deeper tasks route correctly and display actual model plus reported token/cache use.

P0 · Planned — SQ-11: Compact modular answer presentation

Parent: backlog-c271f2bb931810eef633f7c7. Plan: docs/search-quality-plan.md.
Short verdict plus a small useful findings/action table; expandable evidence, gaps, reasons and technical detail. Readable code/JSON/YAML, accessible colour and real measured charts/metrics. Do not show every raw step by default.

P0 · Planned — SQ-12: Quality and performance measurements before/after

Parent: backlog-c271f2bb931810eef633f7c7. Plan: docs/search-quality-plan.md.
Matched samples of factual accuracy, coverage, supported citations, latency, calls, tokens and cost. No critical factual regressions per agreed case; separate quality from speed. Do not invent percentage improvement.

P0 · Planned — SQ-13: User-reviewed learning capture and shared promotion

Parent: backlog-c271f2bb931810eef633f7c7. Plan: docs/search-quality-plan.md.
Offer candidate learning after a verified outcome. User review controls personal-to-shared promotion and repository writes; track corrections, retired cases and source links. Repeated symptoms are not automatically confirmed recurrence.

P0 · Planned — SQ-14: Isolation, migration and end-to-end release verification

Parent: backlog-c271f2bb931810eef633f7c7. Plan: docs/search-quality-plan.md.
Validate source/account/private-mode isolation, permission revocation, secret exclusion, encrypted restore and disabled modules. Each code batch needs relevant local checks and all seven workflows; real-source validation and benchmark gaps stay explicit.

P0 · WIP — SQ-15: Tiny contextual answer-quality labels

Parent: backlog-c271f2bb931810eef633f7c7. Plan: docs/search-quality-plan.md.
Beside token usage for analysis, code reviews, architecture/design and technical notes. Hover/click shows qualitative confidence, coverage, gaps and further investigation. Simple replies stay clean; factual search shows minimal source confidence. No invented accuracy percentages. Persist metadata; validate disabled feature, both provider loops, safe rendering and dismissal.
